title: About Deal Notes
description: Deal Notes is a small, independent site of Amazon buying guides and deal-event explainers run by Sam Barth. How we choose picks and how the site makes money.
intro: Deal Notes is an independent site that helps people shop Amazon with less guesswork: buying guides by category, plain explanations of big sale events, and short news on sales, recalls and product launches.

sections.answer: Deal Notes is run by Sam Barth as part of a small network of sites on samcbarth.com.
body: The other sites in the network are linked in the footer of every page.

sections.answer: We do not run a test lab, and we never claim hands-on testing we did not do. Each pick is a current recommendation in a published, test-based review, which we link, cross-checked against the maker's specs.
body: Each guide has a "How we chose" section that says exactly what it is based on. If a pick is recalled or drops out of the source review, we update or remove it.

sections.h: Where do event dates and news facts come from?
sections.answer: From primary sources: Amazon's own announcements for deal-event dates, the Consumer Product Safety Commission for recalls, and company press releases for product launches.
body: Every news story links its source. If we cannot verify a fact, we leave it out.

sections.h: How does the site make money?
sections.answer: Through affiliate links. When you buy through a "Check price on Amazon" link, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
body: Commissions never decide which products we include. Details are on our affiliate disclosure page.
